text: Someone asked us: why does the same house get such different quotes?
Usually, because the quotes aren't for the same house.
One may include materials. Another, only labour.
One may assume a different type of steel or cement, or leave out plastering, plumbing or electricals.
So don't compare totals. Compare line by line.
Ask each contractor to quote the same list of work and materials, from the same drawing.
Then the difference starts to make sense.
